svg.title: Final test and binning handler
svg.desc: A handler arm picks packaged chips from a tray, places each in a test socket, the tester measures it, and the arm sorts it into a fail, slow-grade or fast-grade bin.
svg.text: The handler loads each packaged chip into a socket; the tester measures it; the result picks the bin.
Some products then also go through SLT (system-level test): run real software in a product-like setup.
Tested hot and cold. One design can ship as different grades. Behavior illustrative.
